parsed.explanation: The displayed divisibility equivalence is precisely the needed fact, but it is asserted with “details omitted,” and the effect on the full tuple is also merely asserted. A sentence can complete both points: assuming α≤β, t divides α and β iff it divides α and β−α; adjoining the unchanged N−2 valuations therefore preserves the common divisors, hence their gcd. Zero and equal valuations are covered by the same equivalence.
